The plate is square, about 390 px across in the image. If it is a side plate of roughly 20 cm, that gives about 19 px per cm.

Each corn piece is about 90-100 px across, so roughly 5 cm in diameter. Their height is not visible, but each looks like a cob slice about 2.5-3 cm thick.

Volume of one slice: π × 2.5² × 2.7 ≈ 53 cm³. The cob core takes up some of that, so I estimate about 45 g of kernels plus cob per slice, or roughly 90 g of kernels. Corn on the cob has a density near 0.9 g/cm³, which puts each slice at about 45-50 g. The slice on the left is slightly smaller, at roughly 40 g.

Total is about 90 g for the two slices.
